messages:
Ines (Finance): FYI a customer in DE flagged that their March invoice total (EUR) is €0.02 higher than the dashboard. They attached the invoice PDF and the dashboard export. Quick glance: it looks like small per-request VAT rounding is accumulating during line-item aggregation.

Sam (Billing): Can you paste the invoice snippet and the dashboard lines? most of these end up being micro-cent diffs from per-line rounding.

Ines (Finance): Paste below — invoice shows per-line VAT rounded to cents:
```
Line A: net 12.34 EUR, VAT 19% = 2.3446 -> VAT shown 2.34, gross 14.68
Line B: net 5.67 EUR, VAT 19% = 1.0773 -> VAT shown 1.08, gross 6.75
Line C: net 0.13 EUR, VAT 19% = 0.0247 -> VAT shown 0.02, gross 0.15
Invoice total net = 18.14, VAT total shown = 3.44, gross = 21.58
Dashboard rollup (raw meter): net = 18.14, VAT computed on total = 3.4426 -> rounded 3.44, gross = 21.58
But ledger generated a credit/charge line and final invoice shows 21.60 for some reason (customer sees +0.02).
```

Maya (Support): Customer screenshot shows invoice line aggregation in the PDF with a rounding adjustment line called "rounding difference" +0.02. They want explanation + immediate fix/credit.

Sam (Billing): Hmm — two possibilities: 1) per-request rounding at token-metering level before aggregation, 2) invoice generator applies a different rounding mode (ceil vs half-even) when summing. We recently changed the meter aggregation to emit per-request VAT as cents for downstream. That could cause drift.

Oliver (Eng): I'll pull aggregator logs. Can you share the metering export for that account and date range? I'll check if the sum of per-request rounded VAT differs from rounding-after-sum. Also confirm currency conversions (no multi-currency here right?).

Ines (Finance): Account export uploaded to /redwood-shared/support-uploads/1778002468/account-947-export.csv (private link). It's EUR-only.

Billing Bot: Invoice-gen job 2026-03-01T03:12:18Z: finished with warnings: "rounding-difference-detected=0.02"; adjustment_line_applied=true. Job id: ig-20260301-947.

Oliver (Eng): Quick read — meter export shows VAT_per_request rounded to 2 decimals before the aggregator sum. Then invoice generator applied another rounding pass using half-up. Combined, we get +0.02 for that billing cycle.

Sam (Billing): Root cause then: metering->emit cents + invoice half-up rounding on totals. Desired policy: either keep full-precision VAT in internal ledger until invoice stage (round at invoice level) OR consistently use same rounding mode across pipeline. Finance prefers rounding at invoice level (one consistent rounding pass).

Liam (Accounts): For remediation: we should issue a one-time credit of €0.02 and regenerate the PDF. Customer consents to a credit and an explanation email. Also flag historical invoices for that account for the last 3 months — could be recurring small drifts.

Oliver (Eng): Action items:
- @Sam update metering export to keep VAT values to 4+ decimals (no cents truncation) by EOD. (PR 5487)
- @Me (Oliver) change invoice-generator rounding mode to half-even and ensure it's the single rounding step at invoice creation. deploy-canary to staging tomorrow.
- Add a nightly job to detect 'rounding-difference-detected' warnings > 0 and alert support with aggregated drift per-account.

Sam (Billing): I'll create a corrective credit (ACCT-947) and send the note template. Also will run a search for invoices with rounding adjustments in the last 90 days.

Maya (Support): I'll draft the customer reply: short apology, explanation (per-request rounding + fix), confirm €0.02 credit and regenerated invoice attached.

Oliver (Eng): Small note for postmortem: consider opt-in per-account policy for VAT rounding rules (per-line vs per-invoice) to support local tax requirements. But default should be consistent and minimize customer surprises.

Ines (Finance): Thanks. Please leave updates here. I'll mark the ticket as escalated until credit is processed.

Sam (Billing): PR created: https://git.redwood/invoice-metering/pull/5487 - kept internal precision, tests added. Will coordinate with Oliver on deploy window.

Oliver (Eng): Deployed invoice-generator fix to staging, ran regression — no double-rounding. Planning prod deploy Thu 04:00 UTC after billing quiet window.

Maya (Support): Customer notified, credit queued, expected refund/credit note in 1-2 business days. They said that's fine and appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

Liam (Accounts): Closing loop once prod deploy done and credit posted.

Billing Bot: Note: follow-up alert created: "rounding-drift-monitor" subtask for SRE/Eng on-call."
